risks.risk: Shutter count may be higher than stated, affecting value and expected wear.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from-camera or a shutter count report tied to the camera’s serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used Nikon Z fc with unknown/high shutter count (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus/haze/scratches not visible in these angles, affecting image quality.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of lens front and rear glass in strong side light (and ideally a short test shot showing contrast/flare).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens with potential optical issues (worst case: treat as not guaranteed clean).

risks.risk: Exact lens model/kit configuration is unclear; could be a different lens or have mechanical issues.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens model/part number markings (or the lens name ring) plus a short video showing autofocus and aperture response.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic kit-lens bundle with unknown lens condition.

risks.risk: Battery health/capacity is unknown; battery may be degraded.
risks.proof: Battery label/model/part number photo and a battery health/cycle count screenshot or runtime test after full charge.
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery health unknown (worst case: reduced runtime).

risks.risk: Camera functional health (IBIS, buttons, EVF/LCD, sensor) is unknown from static photos.
risks.proof: Video of power-on, menu navigation, EVF/LCD switching, autofocus test, and a sensor dust check (bright light/white wall at high f-stop).
risks.if_unproven: Price as fully untested/unknown condition (worst case: assume potential faults until proven).

proof_requests: Send shutter count screenshot/report (ideally showing serial number or camera identity).
Send sharp close-up photos of lens front and rear glass in side light to confirm no fungus/scratches.
Send the exact lens model/part number markings (photo of the lens text).
Send camera serial number photo and a short functional test video (AF + EVF/LCD + buttons).
Send battery health info (cycles/capacity) or a runtime test after full charge.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only a verbal assurance and does not replace the missing decisive evidence. Without shutter count proof, lens-glass inspection, exact lens model, and functional test proof, pricing would be guesswork—so the correct next step is to request the specific proof items.
